name: Tuplet Metronome
summary:
Dual metronome with tuplet control, time signature, GAP mode and a bar-based programmer.

Tuplet Metronome is a precision‑built metronome designed for musicians who need more than a simple click to practice tuplets. It allows you to place different numbers of notes inside any time signature through advanced tuplet control, the GAP silencing system for practice, and a bar‑based Programmer Mode.
